user.title: Add Flespi connection
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should receive data. Each option creates one connection; you can add multiple devices to it afterwards.

menu_options.ha_mqtt: Via Home Assistant MQTT (requires a flespi → local broker bridge)
menu_options.direct: Direct connection to the flespi MQTT broker

ha_mqtt.title: First device (via HA MQTT)
ha_mqtt.description: Add the first device for this HA-MQTT connection. More devices can be added from the integration page after this step.

data_description.dev_id: A unique name for this tracker (e.g. my_car)
data_description.topic: The MQTT topic to subscribe to on the local HA broker

direct.title: Direct connection to flespi
direct.description: How do you want to identify the first device on this connection?

direct_search.title: Find a flespi device
direct_search.description: Enter your token and a name or ident substring. Up to 50 matches shown; narrow the query if you have many devices.

data_description.token: A flespi token with at least read access to the target device(s)
data_description.search: Part of the device name or ident (IMEI)
data_description.auto_discovery: Fetch the device's telemetry snapshot via REST and create a sensor/binary_sensor per recent parameter.
data_description.enable_all_sensors: When off, only common sensors (speed, altitude, fuel, ignition, …) are enabled by default; the rest are added but disabled — enable per device from the entity list. Turn on to activate every auto-discovered sensor immediately.

direct_manual.title: Direct connection — first device
direct_manual.description: Enter your token and the first device. Additional devices can be added later without re-entering the token.

data_description.token: A flespi token with access to the target device(s)
data_description.dev_id: A unique name for this tracker (e.g. my_car)
data_description.flespi_device_id: Numeric device ID from the flespi panel (e.g. 5100080). The MQTT topic is built from this automatically.
data_description.auto_discovery: Fetch the device's telemetry snapshot via REST and create a sensor/binary_sensor per recent parameter.
data_description.enable_all_sensors: When off, only common sensors (speed, altitude, fuel, ignition, …) are enabled by default; the rest are added but disabled — enable per device from the entity list. Turn on to activate every auto-discovered sensor immediately.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Flespi connection
reconfigure.description: Update the flespi token used by every device attached to this connection.

data_description.token: A flespi token with access to the target device(s)

error.invalid_topic: The MQTT topic format is invalid
error.invalid_auth: Flespi rejected the token. Check that it is valid and has access to the device.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the flespi broker. Check the token and your network.
error.no_matches: No devices matched. Refine your search.

abort.already_configured: This connection or device is already configured
abort.nothing_to_configure: This connection has no editable fields (HA-MQTT mode uses Home Assistant's MQTT settings).
